method: train+val: filtered train -> sort(db_id,question,SQL) -> random.Random(42).shuffle -> split 5:1 (train:val); test: BIRD dev verbatim
note: Items carry db_id, not db_path. train/val use the BIRD TRAIN databases; test uses the BIRD DEV databases — set the env's db_root (train/val) and test_db_root (test) accordingly.
